symptom: Span JSONL from another collector either fails with `cannot unmarshal number into Go struct field Span.attrs.server.port` or, with `start_ns`/`end_ns`, parses but every journey shows no runtime reach
cause: Span.Attrs was map[string]string and unknown time keys were ignored, leaving Start = 0
insight: A silently zeroed field is worse than an error: validate the field a later join depends on (start time) at read time, and warn when two inputs that must overlap (spans, journey windows) do not
